# Importing data
```{r}
library(dplyr)
library(purrr)

nh4 <- read_excel("synthetic_soil/Results/nh4_concentration_synthetic.xlsx", col_types = c("text", "numeric"))
names(nh4) <- tolower(names(nh4))
nh4 <- nh4 %>% dplyr::rename(sample = 1, NH4 = 2)

no3 <- read_excel("synthetic_soil/Results/no3_concentration_synthetic.xlsx", col_types = c("text", "numeric"))
names(no3) <- tolower(names(no3))
no3 <- no3 %>% dplyr::rename(sample = 1, NO3 = 2)

bgluco <- read_excel("synthetic_soil/Results/bglucosidase_activity_synthetic.xlsx", col_types = c("text", "numeric", "numeric"))
names(bgluco) <- tolower(names(bgluco))
bgluco <- bgluco %>% dplyr:: select(1, 3)
bgluco <- bgluco %>% dplyr::rename(sample = 1, Bglucosidase = 2)

prot <- read_excel("synthetic_soil/Results/protease_activity_synthetic.xlsx", col_types = c("text", "numeric"))
names(prot) <- tolower(names(prot))
prot <- prot %>% dplyr::rename(sample = 1, Protease = 2)

des <- read_excel("synthetic_soil/Results/desaminase_activity_synthetic.xlsx", col_types = c("text", "numeric"))
names(des) <- tolower(names(des))
des <- des %>% dplyr::rename(sample = 1, Desaminase = 2)

# Merge everything
results <- nh4 %>%
full_join(no3,    by = "sample") %>%
full_join(bgluco, by = "sample") %>%
full_join(prot,   by = "sample") %>%
full_join(des,    by = "sample") %>%
arrange(sample)


results$Bglucosidase[results$Bglucosidase < 0] <- 0
results$Protease[results$Protease < 0] <- 0
results$NO3[results$NO3 < 0] <- 0
results$NH4[results$NH4 < 0] <- 0
results$Desaminase[results$Desaminase < 0] <- 0
```


```{r}
#  Add a "block" column with the prefix (ex: "b1")
results$bloc <- sub("([a-z0-9]+)[a-z][0-9]+", "\\1", results$sample)

#  Add a "soil" column  (a = crop, f = forest)
results$soil <- ifelse(grepl("a", results$sample), "agricole", 
                  ifelse(grepl("f", results$sample), "forestier", NA))

#  Extract the last digit to know the dilution treatment 
results$treatment <- as.numeric(sub(".*([0-9])$", "\\1", results$sample))

# Add dilution treatment
treatment_map <- c("10^-8", "10^-6", "10^-4", "10^-2", "10^0", "0")
results$treatment <- treatment_map[results$treatment]
as.factor(results$treatment)

write_xlsx(results, path = "synthetic_soil/Results/results_synthetic_enzyme_nitrogen.xlsx")

agricole <- results %>%
  filter(soil == "agricole")

forestier <- results %>%
  filter(soil == "forestier")

```

#Crop soil
## Assumptions
### Outliers
```{r}
outlierammonium<- agricole %>%
  group_by(bloc) %>%
  identify_outliers("NH4")

outliernitrate<- agricole %>%
  group_by(bloc) %>%
  identify_outliers("NO3")


outlierprotease<- agricole %>%
  group_by(bloc) %>%
  identify_outliers("Protease")
# b1a6 b4a6

outlierbgluco<- agricole %>%
  group_by(bloc) %>%
  identify_outliers("Bglucosidase")
#b2a1 b3a3

outlierdes<- agricole %>%
  group_by(bloc) %>%
  identify_outliers("Desaminase")
#b1a4 b3a3
```

### Check for normality of residuals
```{r}

# nitrate
model<- lm(sqrt(NO3) ~ treatment, data = agricole)
# QQ plot
ggqqplot(residuals(model))
# Shapiro-Wilk
shapiro_test(residuals(model))
# p.value=0.698

#ammonium
modelamm<- lm( sqrt(NH4) ~ treatment, data = agricole)
# QQ plot
ggqqplot(residuals(modelamm))
# Shapiro-Wilk
shapiro_test(residuals(modelamm))
# p.value=0.335

#protease
modelprot<- lm( sqrt(Protease) ~ treatment, data = agricole)
# QQ plot
ggqqplot(residuals(modelprot))
#  Shapiro-Wilk
shapiro_test(residuals(modelprot))
# p.value=0.0957

#desaminase
modeld<- lm( sqrt(Desaminase) ~ treatment, data = agricole)
# QQ plot 
ggqqplot(residuals(modeld))
# Shapiro-Wilk
shapiro_test(residuals(modeld))
# p.value= 0.000000169

#bglucosidase
modelbglu<- lm( sqrt(Bglucosidase) ~ treatment, data = agricole)
# QQ plot
ggqqplot(residuals(modelbglu))
# Shapiro-Wilk
shapiro_test(residuals(modelbglu))
# p.value=0.5

```

### Check for homogeneity of variances
```{r}
#NITRATE
bartlett.test(sqrt(agricole$NO3), agricole$treatment)
#p-value 0.1824


#AMMONIUM
bartlett.test(sqrt(agricole$NH4), agricole$treatment)
#p-value 0.6581


#PROTEASE
bartlett.test(sqrt(agricole$Protease), agricole$treatment)
#p-value 0.0389


#BGLUCOSIDASE
bartlett.test(sqrt(agricole$Bglucosidase), agricole$treatment)
#p-value 0.3897


#DESAMINASES
bartlett.test(sqrt(agricole$Desaminase), agricole$treatment)
#p-value  2.2<-16
```


## Kruskal-Wallis & ANOVA
```{r}

kw_protease.a <- kruskal.test(agricole$Protease, agricole$treatment)
#p-value = 0.1372

kw_desaminase.a <- kruskal.test(agricole$Desaminase, agricole$treatment)
#p-value 0.6645

aovbglucoa <- aov(sqrt(Bglucosidase) ~ treatment+bloc, data=agricole)
summary(aovbglucoa)
TukeyHSD(aovbglucoa)
#            Df  Sum Sq  Mean Sq F value Pr(>F)  
#treatment    5 0.03835 0.007671   3.279 0.0253 *
#bloc         4 0.00718 0.001794   0.767 0.5591  
#Residuals   20 0.04678 0.002339 

meanbglucoagri<-aggregate(Bglucosidase ~ treatment, data = agricole, mean)

diff4_2 <- (0.8492050/0.1035146)


aovnita<- aov(sqrt(NO3) ~ treatment+bloc, data=agricole)
summary(aovnita)
#            Df   Sum Sq   Mean Sq F value Pr(>F)  
#treatment    5 0.000299 0.0000597   0.375 0.8597  
#bloc         4 0.002156 0.0005391   3.388 0.0286 *
#Residuals   20 0.003183 0.0001591 

aovamma <- aov(sqrt(NH4) ~ treatment+bloc, data=agricole)
summary(aovamma)
#            Df  Sum Sq  Mean Sq F value Pr(>F)
#treatment    5 0.00527 0.001055   0.469  0.794
#bloc         4 0.00921 0.002301   1.024  0.419
#Residuals   20 0.04494 0.002247 
```

## Kruskal-Wallis & ANOVA
```{r}
kw_desaminase.f <- kruskal.test(forestier$Desaminase, forestier$treatment)
#p-value 0.1712

aovnitf <- aov(sqrt(NO3) ~ treatment+bloc, data=forestier)
summary(aovnitf)
#            Df   Sum Sq   Mean Sq F value Pr(>F)
#treatment    5 0.001336 0.0002672   0.460  0.801
#bloc         4 0.000708 0.0001770   0.305  0.871
#Residuals   20 0.011609 0.0005805 

aovammf <- aov(sqrt(NH4) ~ treatment+bloc, data=forestier)
summary(aovammf)
#            Df  Sum Sq Mean Sq F value Pr(>F)
#treatment    5 0.08177 0.01635   1.083  0.399
#bloc         4 0.08005 0.02001   1.326  0.295
#Residuals   20 0.30188 0.01509 

aovprotf <- aov(sqrt(Protease) ~ treatment+bloc, data=forestier)
summary(aovprotf)
TukeyHSD(aovprotf)
#            Df   Sum Sq   Mean Sq F value Pr(>F)  
#treatment    5 0.002259 0.0004517   2.893  0.040 *
#bloc         4 0.001980 0.0004949   3.170  0.036 *
#Residuals   20 0.003123 0.0001561

meanprotfo<-aggregate(Protease ~ treatment, data = forestier, mean)
#  treatment Protease
#         0 2.759710
#     10^-2 1.206323
#     10^-4 4.367463
#     10^-6 5.603612
#     10^-8 1.102162
#      10^0 5.080524
aovbglucof <- aov(sqrt(Bglucosidase) ~ treatment+bloc, data=forestier)
summary(aovbglucof)
#            Df  Sum Sq  Mean Sq F value Pr(>F)  
#treatment    5 0.01929 0.003859   2.349 0.0785 .
#bloc         4 0.00533 0.001333   0.811 0.5326  
#Residuals   20 0.03285 0.001643 

```

# Create dataframes
```{r}
kw_protease.a_df <- data.frame(
  variable  = "Protease",
  factor    = "treatment",
  test      = "Kruskal-Wallis",
  statistic = kw_protease.a$statistic,
  df        = kw_protease.a$parameter,
  p         = kw_protease.a$p.value
)

kw_desaminase.a_df <- data.frame(
  variable  = "Desaminase",
  factor    = "treatment",
  test      = "Kruskal-Wallis",
  statistic = kw_desaminase.a$statistic,
  df        = kw_desaminase.a$parameter,
  p         = kw_desaminase.a$p.value
)

a.aov.nit_df <- broom::tidy(aovnita)
a.aov.amm_df <- broom::tidy(aovamma)
a.aov.bgluco_df <- broom::tidy(aovbglucoa)

write_xlsx(
  list(
    "kw_protease_agricole" = kw_protease.a_df,
    "kw_desaminase_agricole" = kw_desaminase.a_df ,
    "Anova_nitrate_agricole" = a.aov.nit_df,
    "Anova_bglucosidase_agricole" = a.aov.bgluco_df,
    "Anova_ammonium_agricole" = a.aov.amm_df
  ),
  path = here("synthetic_soil/Results/synthetic_crop_statistic.xlsx")
)

kw_desaminase.f_df <- data.frame(
  variable  = "Desaminase",
  factor    = "treatment",
  test      = "Kruskal-Wallis",
  statistic = kw_desaminase.f$statistic,
  df        = kw_desaminase.f$parameter,
  p         = kw_desaminase.f$p.value
)


f.aov.bgluco_df <- broom::tidy(aovbglucof)
f.aov.nit_df <- broom::tidy(aovnitf)
f.aov.amm_df <- broom::tidy(aovammf)
f.aov.prot_df <- broom::tidy(aovprotf)

write_xlsx(
  list(
    "Anova_protease_forest" = f.aov.prot_df,
    "Anova_ammonium_forest" = f.aov.amm_df ,
    "Anova_nitrate_forest" = f.aov.nit_df,
    "Anova_bglucosidase_forest" = f.aov.bgluco_df,
    "kw_desaminase_forest" = kw_desaminase.f_df
  ),
  path = here("synthetic_soil/Results/synthetic_forest_statistic.xlsx")
)
```

```{r}
library(ggplot2)

# Color forest
couleurs <- c("10^0" = "#006D2C","10^-2" = "#31A354","10^-4" = "#74C476","10^-6" = "#BAE4B3","10^-8" = "#EDF8E9","0" = "grey80")

forest <- forestier
forest$treatment <- factor(forest$treatment, levels = names(couleurs))

plotnitf <- ggplot(forest, aes(x=treatment, y=NO3, fill=treatment, colour=treatment)) + 
  geom_boxplot(outlier.shape = NA, alpha=0.5) + 
  geom_point(size=2, alpha=0.2) + 
  theme_classic() + 
  labs(y="Nitrate (mg/g soil)", x=NULL) + 
  scale_fill_manual(values = couleurs) + 
  scale_color_manual(values = couleurs) + 
  ggtitle("Nitrate concentration") +scale_x_discrete(labels = c("0" = "CTL", 
                              "10^-8" = "D8", 
                              "10^-6" = "D6",
                              "10^-4" = "D4", 
                              "10^-2" = "D2", 
                              "10^0" = "D0"))+

    panel.grid.major = element_blank(), 
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank(), 
    panel.background = element_blank(), 
    panel.grid = element_blank(), 
    axis.line = element_line(colour = "gray95", size=0))+
  ylim(0,0.10)

  scale_color_manual(values = couleursa) + 
  ggtitle("Deaminase activity") + scale_x_discrete(labels = c("0" = "CTL", 
                              "10^-8" = "D8", 
                              "10^-6" = "D6",
                              "10^-4" = "D4", 
                              "10^-2" = "D2", 
                              "10^0" = "D0")) +
  theme(
    panel.grid.major = element_blank(), 
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank(), 
    panel.background = element_blank(), 
    panel.grid = element_blank(), 
    axis.line = element_line(colour = "gray95", size=0)) 

```

# plot together
```{r}
library(ggpubr)
library(cowplot)

max_prot <- max(c(agri$Protease, forest$Protease), na.rm = TRUE)
ylim_prot <- c(0, max_prot * 1.05)
plotprota <- plotprota + coord_cartesian(ylim = ylim_prot)
plotprotf <- plotprotf + coord_cartesian(ylim = ylim_prot)

max_bgluco <- max(c(agri$Bglucosidase, forest$Bglucosidase), na.rm = TRUE)
ylim_bgluco <- c(0, max_bgluco * 1.05)
plotbglucoa <- plotbglucoa + coord_cartesian(ylim = ylim_bgluco)
plotbglucof <- plotbglucof + coord_cartesian(ylim = ylim_bgluco)

max_des <- max(c(agri$Desaminase, forest$Desaminase), na.rm = TRUE)
ylim_des <- c(0, max_des * 1.05)
plotdesa <- plotdesa + coord_cartesian(ylim = ylim_des)
plotdesf <- plotdesf + coord_cartesian(ylim = ylim_des)

# Remove legends
plotprota <- plotprota + labs(fill = "Crop dilution", colour = "Crop dilution")
plotprotf <- plotprotf + labs(fill = "Forest dilution", colour = "Forest dilution")

plotprota   <- plotprota   + theme(legend.position = "none")
plotbglucoa <- plotbglucoa + theme(legend.position = "none")
plotdesa    <- plotdesa    + theme(legend.position = "none")
plotprotf   <- plotprotf   + theme(legend.position = "none")
plotbglucof <- plotbglucof + theme(legend.position = "none")
plotdesf    <- plotdesf    + theme(legend.position = "none")


#  Crop Legend
legend1 <- get_legend(
  plotprota +
    labs(fill = "Crop dilution", colour = "Crop dilution") +
    scale_fill_manual(values = couleursa,
                      labels = c("0" = "CTL", "10^-8" = "D8",
                                 "10^-6" = "D6", "10^-4" = "D4",
                                 "10^-2" = "D2", "10^0"  = "D0")) +
    scale_color_manual(values = couleursa,
                       labels = c("0" = "CTL", "10^-8" = "D8",
                                  "10^-6" = "D6", "10^-4" = "D4",
                                  "10^-2" = "D2", "10^0"  = "D0")) +
    theme(legend.position = "bottom",
          legend.background = element_rect(fill = "transparent", color = NA),
          legend.key = element_rect(fill = "transparent", color = NA))
)

# Forest legend
legend2 <- get_legend(
  plotprotf +
    labs(fill = "Forest dilution", colour = "Forest dilution") +
    scale_fill_manual(values = couleurs,
                      labels = c("0" = "CTL", "10^-8" = "D8",
                                 "10^-6" = "D6", "10^-4" = "D4",
                                 "10^-2" = "D2", "10^0"  = "D0")) +
    scale_color_manual(values = couleurs,
                       labels = c("0" = "CTL", "10^-8" = "D8",
                                  "10^-6" = "D6", "10^-4" = "D4",
                                  "10^-2" = "D2", "10^0"  = "D0")) +
    theme(legend.position = "bottom",
          legend.background = element_rect(fill = "transparent", color = NA),
          legend.key = element_rect(fill = "transparent", color = NA))
)





ligne1 <- ggarrange(plotprota, plotbglucoa, plotdesa,
                    ncol = 3, labels = c("A","B","C"))
ligne2 <- ggarrange(plotprotf, plotbglucof, plotdesf,
                    ncol = 3, labels = c("D","E","F"))

# Merge legend
legends <- plot_grid(legend1, legend2, ncol = 2)


figure_final <- plot_grid(
  ligne1,
  ligne2,
  legends,
  ncol = 1,
  rel_heights = c(1, 0.8, 0.2)
)



ggsave("synthetic_soil/Figures/Fig_3_Enzyme_synt.tiff",plot=figure_final, dpi=600, compression="lzw",   width = 12.07,
  height = 10.01,
  units = "in")
```
